name: kawhig7
caption:
39 SHOTS 🎮🏀 Everybody remembers Kawhi's last shot in Game 7. He took 38 others.

• May 12, 2019, Game 7 vs Philly: 41 PTS on 16-of-39, 8 REB
• Everyone else on our team combined: 51 points
• We win 92-90 on the bounce, then he averages 30.5 PPG in the playoffs and wins Finals MVP
• Now 35 and back with us: 23 on 17 shots on opening night
• Scottie Barnes leads us at 23.5 PPG through 8 games

Game 7 tonight, last shot: Kawhi or Scottie? 👇

beats.head: 39 SHOTS
beats.name: KAWHI
beats.vo: Everybody remembers the shot. Nobody talks about the other thirty-eight. In Game seven against Philly, Kawhi Leonard took thirty-nine shots.
beats.dlg: EVERYONE KNOWS THE SHOT.|KAWHI TOOK 39 OF THEM.

beats.head: 41 POINTS
beats.name: KAWHI
beats.vo: He made sixteen of them. Forty-one points. Everybody else on our team combined: fifty-one.

beats.head: THE RUN
beats.name: KAWHI
beats.vo: The last one dropped at the buzzer, ninety-two to ninety. He averaged thirty point five that whole playoff run, and won Finals MVP.

beats.head: NOW
beats.name: KAWHI
beats.vo: Now he's back with us at thirty-five. Opening night: twenty-three points on seventeen shots. But Scottie Barnes leads us at twenty-three point five a game.

beats.head: GAME 7 TONIGHT
beats.vo: Game seven tonight, one shot to win it. Kawhi, or Scottie? Comment below.
beats.dlg: GAME 7 TONIGHT, LAST SHOT:|KAWHI OR SCOTTIE?

facts.claim: Game 7, May 12, 2019 vs Philadelphia: Toronto scored 92 on 34-89 shooting; Leonard 41 on 16-39, so his teammates scored 51 on 50 shots; 38 shots besides the last one
Leonard's buzzer-beater won Game 7 92-90, the first Game 7 buzzer beater in NBA history; he won 2019 Finals MVP; born June 29, 1991 (age 35); back with Toronto
Oct 21, 2026 vs Chicago was Toronto's opening night of 2026-27; Leonard had 23 points on 17 shots
